title: SpaceX and Elon Musk Deliver Fantastic News for Nvidia Stock Investors | NVDA Stock Analysis
creator: Parkevtate Vosianc CFA
summary: Parkevtate Vosianc revisits Nvidia after SpaceX said it closed $40 billion in debt financing to buy Nvidia GPUs for AI, a move he calls fantastic news for Nvidia investors. He reads SpaceX's decision to rent out computing capacity it built, rather than chase frontier AI models itself, as prudent, noting SpaceX still needs AI technology, including Grok in Tesla vehicles, but does not need to lead the field. The valuation argument follows: Nvidia trades at a forward price-to-earnings ratio of 13.6, near its cheapest in several years, despite a market capitalisation above $5.2 trillion. He forecasts free cash flow above $190 billion in the fiscal year ending January 2027, rising to $475 billion by 2030, supported by five companies spending over $900 billion on data centres in 2026 and an estimated $1.4 trillion in 2027, with Nvidia holding a 70-90% share of data-centre GPUs. He ranks Nvidia his top stock to buy right now with high conviction, owns it as one of his largest positions, and is interested in adding more. The call is NVDA — BUY reiterated. He adds only a general warning that no stock is without risk.
